description: Lists upcoming U.S. federal tax deadlines with days remaining: quarterly estimated payments (1040-ES), individual return and extension dates, and optionally S-corporation, partnership and C-corporation return and estimated-tax dates. Dates are already moved off weekends and holidays.

from_date.description: List deadlines on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (U.S. Central).

include_business.description: Also list business return and C-corporation estimated tax dates.

limit.description: Maximum number of deadlines to return.

name: list_federal_tax_deadlines
title: Upcoming federal tax deadlines
